paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.17% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.19%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.60%). Brent crude changed -0.06% to 102.25. Gold changed -0.95% to 4,162.2998. Bitcoin changed +0.66% to 85,323.7578. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +0.76%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.98%) and Glencore (+2.95%) moved the most.
